data.gender_notes: Izzani is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘IZZ’ meaning intelligence, and ‘ANI’ meaning noble. A beautiful name for a daughter, conveying intelligence, nobility, and courage. The name Izzani carries the meaning “Intelligent, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Izzani usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires a sense of inner wisdom and knowledge, as well as a strong sense of morality and ethics.
data.etymology: Izzani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izzani total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عزاني
in_arabic.meaning: معنى اسم عزاني هو العزة والكرامة
in_arabic.long_meaning: معنى اسم عزاني هو العزة والكرامة والشرف، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي عزا الذي يعني العلو والشرف، وقد ذکر هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان، ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء المهمة في الثقافة الإسلامية لما يحمله من معاني عالية

in_urdu.name: عزانی
in_urdu.meaning: عزانی کا معنی عزت اور کرامت ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزانی کا معنی عزت اور کرامت ہے، اور یہ نام عربي جڑ عزی سے ماخوذ ہے جو بلندی اور شرف کا معنی دیتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامي ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ بلند اور شرف کے معنی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے
